thread:
oliver: Heads-up: AtlasRail (HW integrator) requested a joint proof-of-concept next Thursday. They want a flow that demonstrates: LangChain orchestrating a retrieval pipeline with LlamaIndex, hitting our gateway, and serving from a Dedicated cluster. They also asked about a marketplace bundle and an orchestration plugin for OrchX. Who can pick this up?

priya: I can take the LangChain/LlamaIndex wiring and validate sample notebooks. I need to confirm whether OrchX will run tasks server-side or send direct calls to our API. That affects how we show caching. ETA for a smoke summary: Wed AM.

marco: Ill handle gateway integration and the OrchX plugin contract. Quick note: OrchX currently expects a webhook handshake on deploy; we should define a small adapter that translates OrchX task callbacks to our /v1/stream endpoint. Ill prototype a shim.

leah: Ops concern: AtlasRail images use an older OpenSSL and their staging endpoint uses a self-signed intermediate. Ops-bot, please file a cert acceptance ticket. We may need to run the demo behind a reverse proxy if cert rotation won't happen in time. Also request a 90-minute window to deploy the gateway shim: Wed 01:00-02:30 UTC.

ops-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-6173: "AtlasRail cert bundle + gateway shim maintenance" assigned to @leah and @marco.

priya: Found a LlamaIndex vector key collision risk when OrchX runs multi-tenant ingestion jobs concurrently. Suggest a namespaced key strategy. Example patch to test locally: ```python
# namespaced key for multi-tenant ingestion
def lindex_cache_key(tenant_id, doc_hash):
    return f"atlas:{tenant_id}:lindex:{doc_hash}"
```

marco: Good catch. For OrchX plugin, Ill include a config flag to toggle key namespacing. Also planning to add a small retry for webhook delivery to avoid lost callbacks.

leah: Maintenance/rollback plan: deploy shim to staging, smoke test with a single OrchX job. If error rate > 0.5% in 5 minutes, revert routing to legacy path and abort ongoing demo. Ill post runbook steps once window confirmed.

oliver: Marketing/legal note: well not do a public marketplace listing until the co-marketing terms are signed. Legal-team, please start a co-announcement review. We can prepare draft marketplace assets in parallel.

legal-team: Filing COANN-2024 for review. Turnaround estimate 48 hours. Please attach partner slides and any customer quotes to the ticket.

priya: Also, OrchX wants streaming examples. Quick local streaming test (dev): ```bash
curl -N -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_DEV" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-stream-01","input":"extract:entities"}'
```

marco: Ill add the OrchX adapter repo and post a deploy checklist. Timeline proposal: Wed AM - Priya smoke tests; Wed 01:00-02:30 UTC - deploy shim; Wed 09:00 internal run-through; Thu 14:00 partner demo. If legal signoff delayed, we still demo privately but hold marketplace assets.

leah: Confirmed. Ops will standby during the maintenance window and run quick health checks post-deploy. Ill also prepare a short postmortem template in case anything regresses.

oliver: Action owners recap: Priya -> LangChain/LlamaIndex smoke tests and streaming examples; Marco -> OrchX plugin + gateway shim + deploy checklist; Leah -> cert ticket + maintenance scheduling + rollback runbook; Legal-team -> co-announcement review. Ill own partner scheduling and marketplace asset prep.

priya: One last note - for the demo script we should highlight cost/latency tradeoffs: show with and without prefix caching enabled so OrchX customers can see unit economics. Ill draft a short table for the slides.

marco: Posting prototype adapter link and minimal config in next message.

ops-bot: PARTNER-6173 updated with staging cert bundle uploaded by AtlasRail.

leah: Great. If anyone finds a blocker, flag here immediately. Well hold the thread as canonical for this integration. :white_check_mark:
